entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and I'm just so lost with all this.
I can certainly help you look into a return. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know about technical. It's just... the color is all wrong. My daughter said it's not good for visibility and safety on the road. The whole box is unopened, I was too nervous to even take it out. I tried looking at the policy online and it just confused me more. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help with that. No need to worry. Let me just pull up your order details. I see the helmet was delivered 32 days ago. One moment while I confirm the return eligibility.
Okay... I hope it's not too late. I just get so overwhelmed.
Not at all. I've checked the policy, and for a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's a relief! So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the timeframe, I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I am now sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. You can just print that out and attach it to the box.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Isaac! You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could assist. Once we receive the item, you can expect a full refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
